test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

I have taken care that the door is locked and the window ____ fastened.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**securely**" means in a manner that is free from risk or danger. (सुरक्षित तरीके से)
 
• It fits contextually in the sentence as the phrase "the window securely fastened" implies that it is tightly and safely closed.
 
• The other options: "**deeply**," "**unfixed**," and "**safely** do not convey the exact meaning required in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** I have taken care that the door is locked and the window securely__ fastened.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Deeply (गहराई से)**: means in an intense or profound manner, generally used for emotions or thoughts.
 
• **Unfixed (अस्थिर)**: means not fixed; loose or unsettled.
 
• **Safely (सुरक्षित तरीके से)**: means in a manner that is free from harm or danger, similar to "securely" but less contextually appropriate for fastening an object.

3a:Tc86,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
